name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-inner-json-modification-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; the value methods listed are value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The expected panic on updating the nested JSON map depends essentially on cloneReadOnly() recursively freezing the cloned value. cloneReadOnly is absent from both the supported lang.value methods and the permitted langlib method-call list, so this behavior is outside subset 10.
unsupported_constructs: j2.cloneReadOnly() and its recursive readonly-clone behavior
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion targets assignment through an alias to the cloned inner map; supported mapping constructors, member access and casts alone do not establish this readonly state.
